title: Cybersecurity Compliance Manager
description:
Trident Consulting is seeking a " Cybersecurity Compliance Manager” for one of our client in " Aliso Viejo, CA” A global leader in a Medical devices.

Role: Cybersecurity Compliance Manager
Location: Aliso Viejo, CA
Job Type: Contract

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Compliance Manager to lead a six-month cybersecurity compliance initiative focused on maturing the organization's NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) program. This is a hands-on leadership role where you will assess the current cybersecurity posture, develop a maturity roadmap, establish governance processes, and create sustainable documentation and controls that can be transitioned to the internal team.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong project management and cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) experience who can work independently and drive cross-functional initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead a NIST CSF maturity assessment and develop a prioritized roadmap.
  • Perform cybersecurity gap assessments and map existing controls to NIST CSF.
  • Develop and maintain cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation.
  • Build and manage project plans, milestones, risk registers, dashboards, and executive status reports.
  • Coordinate with IT, Engineering, Quality, Legal, and Regulatory teams to drive compliance initiatives.
  • Facilitate risk assessments, document findings, and track remediation activities.
  • Design repeatable governance processes, evidence collection templates, and control documentation.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior GRC team members.
  • Deliver executive presentations, stakeholder communications, and knowledge transfer documentation.

Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), or Information Security.
  • Hands-on experience with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) or equivalent frameworks such as NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or CMMC.
  • Strong project or program management experience with proven ability to lead complex initiatives.
  • Experience conducting cybersecurity assessments, gap analyses, and risk management activities.
  • Strong experience developing policies, procedures, standards, and governance documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and drive projects with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in regulated industries such as Medical Devices, Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, Financial Services, or Defense.
  • Knowledge of NIST CSF 2.0.
  • Experience with GRC platforms such as ServiceNow GRC, Archer, Drata, or Vanta.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGRC/CAP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer.

What We're Looking For
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to drive initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Experience building cybersecurity compliance programs and governance processes from the ground up.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and communicate effectively with technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments.

About Trident Consulting
Trident Consulting is an award-winning staffing and consulting firm headquartered in San Ramon, CA. Since 2005, we've partnered with Fortune 500 and high-growth companies to deliver high-quality talent across technology, engineering, business operations, and professional services.

We specialize in contract, contract-to-hire, and direct hire placements, supporting roles across IT, data & analytics, cloud, cybersecurity, finance & accounting, HR, operations, and more. With a strong focus on hard-to-fill and niche positions, our global recruiting engine enables us to deliver speed, quality, and scale

title: Lead Gen AI/Agentic AI Engineer
description:
Trident Consulting is seeking a " Lead Gen AI/Agentic AI Engineer ” for one of our clients in " Charlotte, NC or Remote "

Job Title: Lead Gen AI/Agentic AI Engineer
Location: Hybrid at Charlotte, NC or Remote working EST hours
Length of Assignment: 1 year w/ extension
Type: Contract (W2)
Rate:$62/hr
Interview Process: Internal & Client (Onsite Interviews Mandatory)
**Candidate must be willing to attend in-person interviews with Cognizant or our client, either in nearest Cognizant office location or client location.**


Job Summary:
We are looking for a highly experienced and driven Senior GenAI/Agentic AI Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of next-generation intelligent applications and autonomous agents. This role is pivotal in revolutionizing business operations through advanced AI technologies. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Generative AI, prompt engineering, agentic orchestration, and the full AWS Machine Learning and Data ecosystem.

• Develop MVP User Stories (Re-usable components/etc.)
• Support backlog creation, prioritization, and Story mapping
• Support in technical design and solutioning
• Ability to work across tiers – APIs, databases (basic developer tasks)
• Ability to utilize DevOps CI/CD pipeline, create/configure build and deploy jobs
• Experience working in XP and pair programming model and understands and performs TDD
• Responsible for assigned task delivery and quality and knowledge transfer through daily pairing
• Must be able to clearly communicate with team members and leadership
• Participate in paired programming and XP development
• Strong ability to work independently when required
• Turn complex ideas into manageable pieces of work
• Hands-on, Individual contribution and Mentor other developers in team
• Support team members on troubleshooting

Required Skills:
• AWS Proficiency: Extensive hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock, Agent Core Platform, AWS Strands, SageMaker, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, and other core AWS services like Redshift, Aurora Postgres, Glue, EMR, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch.
• Generative AI Mastery: Practical experience with foundational models (e.g., Anthropic Claude, Stability AI, Llama variants), including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and safety mechanisms.
• Programming Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python and its data science stack (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
• Vector & Database Systems: Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, or RDS Vector Store for RAG implementations.
• Agentic Frameworks: Proven experience with orchestration tools like LangChain and LlamaIndex for building autonomous agents.
Additional Skills & Expertise -
• Infrastructure as Code: Proficient in Terraform and Terraform Enterprise for scalable, automated infrastructure provisioning.
• CI/CD Pipelines: Experienced with Concourse and GitHub Actions for continuous integration and deployment workflows.
• Data Lakehouse Engineering: Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg and a strong understanding of medallion architecture principles.
• Open Table Formats: Skilled in building and optimizing Data Lakehouse solutions using open table formats to enhance performance and scalability.
• 10+ years of experience in ML, NLP, AI system design with 1-2 years in Gen AI or Agentic AI (preferably 12-15 yrs)

Additional Information:
• Number of interview rounds expected: 2-3
• Candidate must be willing to attend in-person interviews with Cognizant or our client, either in nearest Cognizant office location or client location.
• For virtual interviews, Candidate must appear on video during all interviews and stay on video and audio for the entire duration of the interview timeslot.
• Candidate must be ready for photo-id verification on all interview rounds.
• No AI usage during interviews is permitted. Vendors must make sure candidates comply with Cognizant policy on AI usage and ethical standards.
• Good communication, pair programming and ability to work in multi-stakeholder team setup in must.
